releaseNotes:
- Treats Codex and OpenCode as two adapters of one AI SDK Harness execution
  layer: both now share the same concurrent workspace, model-routing,
  approval, warm-session, and lifecycle rules instead of carrying separate
  process-ownership assumptions
- Reuses one Codex app-server or one OpenCode native Server inside each
  physical workspace while keeping an independent native Thread or Session,
  lightweight AI SDK Bridge, signed model lease, message stream, timer, and
  approval continuation for every AgentOS conversation
- Allows different conversations using the same Agent and workspace to run at
  the same time without starting a full Harness core for every message or
  stopping another conversation's warm Bridge when users switch between them
- Reuses one multi-Run AgentOS Gateway and one Core-owned reverse model Relay
  per physical workspace. Every model request carries its own signed lease, so
  concurrent conversations cannot exchange provider routes, models, output
  ceilings, or credentials
- Shares one local or Cube workspace sandbox across concurrent logical
  conversations with reference-counted ownership, per-conversation process
  cleanup, dynamic Bridge ports, and last-reference physical stop or destroy
- Hydrates a shared durable workspace once for a concurrent conversation
  cohort and checkpoints it once after the last conversation releases it,
  while still serializing incompatible provider or template generations
- Keeps the existing one-unfinished-Run rule within one AgentOS conversation;
  concurrency is intentionally across independent conversations for both
  Agent-shared and user-isolated workspace modes
- Ships with AgentOS Runtime `1.0.0-beta.9`, which contains the matching shared
  Gateway, Codex app-server transport, and OpenCode native-service recipes
- Does not change the public TypeScript or Java SDK request/response schemas

### Verification

- Passed TypeScript checking, the complete production build, and all 344
  TypeScript, Server, UI, and TypeScript SDK tests
- Passed symmetric Codex and OpenCode approval-continuation tests, concurrent
  signed-lease isolation, concurrent durable-workspace hydration, and shared
  local/Cube physical-sandbox lifecycle coverage
